scope: Keyboard reachability, provenance activation, accessible names and visible focus for montage cells
repairs: Each real crop takes StrongFocus, allowing normal Tab traversal into and out of the montage.
Unmodified Return, numeric Enter and Space emit the same provenance payload as a left click, only while the crop owns focus.
Accessible names reuse the existing full provenance summary; no new user-facing strings.
Keyboard focus shares the existing current-cell ring. Leaving hover preserves focused appearance, and leaving focus restores resting/candidate appearance.
validation: Real _WellTab with two synthetic measured rows and two synthetic crops; normal i18n accessibility pass applied.
Actual detail dialogs contain the selected cell provenance while measured rows and crop arrays remain unchanged.
Control/Alt/Shift combinations do not activate; existing left/right mouse activation and paint/provenance checks pass.
QAccessible names/focusability and actual rendered focus/hover/resting pixels are checked.
api_reason: The normal public_docstrings collector excludes the private _Thumb class, including its event overrides.
limits: QAccessible metadata and offscreen painting are verified, not external-reader speech or native Windows/macOS behavior.
No whole-application keyboard or tutorial acceptance is claimed.
